name: SnapPad

commands: brew install cmake ninja jq ripgrep uv rust gcc

notes: Manifest owned by the game repository: pinned ROM-free sources, the player's ROM decompiled privately and an ahead-of-time core; the copy stays personal.

inputs.description: Your own Pokémon Snap (USA) ROM. It is checked and decompiled privately on this Mac during the build and never leaves it.

publication.reason: Each copy holds game code made from the player's own ROM on their own Mac, so it stays personal.

steps: Open {file} and move SnapPad.app to your Applications folder.
Open SnapPad and choose the same Pokémon Snap (USA) ROM when it asks; it keeps a private copy on this Mac.
Updating? Replace the old SnapPad.app with the new one. Your saves are kept.
